notes: Thresholds are deliberately generous: CI runners are slower and noisier than the reference box, and the gate exists to catch structural regressions (a lost support-compression or cached-W win), not 20% noise. Ratio checks are machine-speed invariant and carry the tighter limits; absolute checks are large multiples of reference-box medians. Recalibrate against real runner numbers once the gate has CI history.

tensor_multiplier_exact.note: measured 3.77; the pre-arc tensor-cost reversion is 7.2x, which must trip

tensor_multiplier_discrete.note: measured 2.96 (pre-arc 3.8 is inside noise); guards catastrophic tensor-path blowups

absolute_multiple.note: per-case median vs reference-box median; trips on the 6.6x pre-arc base-exact reversion even on a 2-3x slower runner
limit 4.23s: healthy CI ~2x reference leaves 2x margin, pre-arc 2.102s median on a slow runner (~5.3s) trips
